Substance X contains one cation.
Two tests are completed on aqueous X.
test 1
flame test
test 2
addition of aqueous sodium hydroxide dropwise and then in excess
Which row shows a possible combination of observations for the tests?
observation for test 1
observation for test 2

yellow flame
white ppt., insoluble in excess
B
blue-green flame
light blue ppt., insoluble in excess
C
light green flame
green ppt., soluble in excess

red flame
red-brown ppt., insoluble in excess
